annotations.title: Calculate net salary in Finland (gross to net, employer cost)

description: Gross-to-net salary calculator for Finland, from the JobCrawls tax iceberg calculator. Example queries: "what is 4000 gross net in Finland", "paljonko jää käteen 4200 euron bruttopalkasta Helsingissä", "vad blir nettolönen på 3800 brutto i Helsingfors". Inputs: a gross salary (EUR per month by default, or per year), or a target net to solve the gross it takes, and optionally the municipality, employer size, age, dependent children, commuting costs and investment income. Church membership and union fees are not inputs. The linked page is in the language detected from "municipality" when locale is omitted, else English, or in the given locale. Returns monthly and annual breakdowns: employee pension and unemployment contributions, state, municipal, church and Yle taxes, net pay, employer contributions and the true cost of employment, plus the effective tax rate, the assumptions used and a link to the same scenario on jobcrawls.com. Uses the current tax year's official Finnish parameters; an estimate, not tax advice.

age.description: Age in years, affects pension and unemployment contributions.

capitalGains.description: Capital gains net of acquisition cost in the same period.

commutingCosts.description: Commuting costs in the same period; deductible above the own-liability share, capped.

dependentChildren.description: Number of dependent children, affects the child tax deduction.

dividends.description: Listed-company dividends in the same period (capital income).

employerSize.description: Employer payroll size for the unemployment-insurance rate (large = payroll above about EUR 2.5 million). Omit for a blended average.

gross.description: Gross salary in euros, per month unless period is "year". Either gross or net is required.

includeVat.description: Also subtract the VAT paid when the net is spent (an estimate). Default false.

isSoleGuardian.description: Single parent with dependent children (child deduction).

locale.description: Language of the user's message (fi for Finnish, sv for Swedish, en for English or any other language), including when job titles or place names in it are English. Language of the result notes, the inline card and the linked page. When omitted, detected from "municipality" if it is given in Finnish or Swedish form; otherwise defaults to en.

municipality.description: Finnish municipality, by its Finnish or Swedish name, e.g. "Helsinki", "Helsingfors" or "Espoo". Omit for the national-average municipal tax rate.

net.description: Target net pay in euros (same period): the tool solves the gross salary that leaves this in hand. Either gross or net is required.

period.description: Period of every money amount given. Default month.

unlistedDividends.description: Dividends from the person's own unlisted company in the same period (8% yield rule).

unlistedNetAssets.description: Mathematical value of the person's shares in that company, EUR (a stock, not per period).

name: calculate_net_salary_finland

destinations.description: Where the taxes and contributions go, EUR per year.

input.description: The inputs the calculation used, after defaults.

targetNet.description: The target net when the gross was solved from one.

investments.description: Capital income breakdown, or null when no investment income was given.

trueEmployerCost.description: Gross plus employer contributions: what employing the person costs.

pageUrl.description: The same scenario on jobcrawls.com, where church tax and union fees can be set privately.

effectiveRatePct.description: Taxes plus employee contributions, as % of gross.

taxRatePct.description: Taxes only, as % of gross (the tax card rate).
